caption:
i was waiting for day 21 to feel easy.

it didn't. now i know why.

what habit are you in the hard part of right now? 👇

slides.text:
they said it takes 21 days to build a habit
so i looked it up
slides.image: alarm list sheets waking up early routine

slides.query: where does the 21 day habit rule come from
slides.result: It traces back to Maxwell Maltz's 1960 book Psycho-Cybernetics, which said change takes **a minimum of about 21 days.**

slides.text:
a minimum
somewhere along the way it became a promise
slides.image: watch wrist dark grey time discipline

slides.query: how long does it actually take to form a habit
slides.result: In a study of 96 people, habits took **about 66 days** on average to become automatic, anywhere from 18 to 254 days.
slides.source: Lally et al., European Journal of Social Psychology (2009)
slides.image: track at night floodlight rain discipline

slides.text:
so if day 21 still feels like work
nothing is wrong with you
slides.image: running blur dark night run motion

slides.text:
i'm still in the part where it's not automatic
still showing up
slides.image: phone alarms dark bedding waking early

slides.text:
day 66 is further than you think
but closer than yesterday
slides.image: fog forest road lone runner path
